captureMode: PE metadata/resource read only; HIDMaestro.Core.dll not loaded; no driver, Host, virtual controller, device, Steam or game operation

xbox360.staticDisposition: DS4 IMU plane absent; persona-motion-unsupported remains required.

hcReference.dualshock4: DualShock4Target: InputLength=31; GamepadMotion raw gyro encodes at bytes 19..24 after clamp ±2048 and *16; accel at 25..30 after g*9.81 clamp ±64 and *512.
hcReference.xbox360: Xbox360Target: InputLength=20 and BuildReport does not encode GamepadMotion IMU.

currentProductCandidate.inputHost: Program.cs sets HMGamepadState.GyroDpsX/Y/Z only; it does not assign AccelX/Y/Z.

staticConclusion: HIDMaestro profile resources are statically captured; descriptor identity/report ID/report size/field offsets/endianness are no longer unknown.
HC VIIPER DS4 wire layout and HIDMaestro DS4 v2 wire layout are not byte-identical; direct HC offset reuse is prohibited.
HC motion/lifecycle semantics may be retained only through a descriptor-specific semantic adapter.

The static material does not prove GyroDpsX/Y/Z or AccelX/Y/Z to report-field axis/sign/unit/scale encoding, SubmitState readback, virtual-device enumeration, consumer observation, neutral/release, or recovery.
safeStop: no direct IMU publication until T12 transport mapping and T15/T16 runtime evidence are complete
